s: Which one of the following is not a Harappan site?
x: Sohgaura is not a Harappan site: Sohgaura, located in the Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh near the Rapti and Ami rivers, is a significant archaeological site showcasing a multi-cultural sequence from the Neolithic to the early historic period. The Sohgaura copper plate inscription is the oldest known copper plate inscription in India, dating to the Mauryan period (3 rd century BCE). Discovered in the Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh, it records one of history's earliest examples of famine relief and proactive state welfare. Chanhudaro is a Harappan site: It is located 130 km south of Mohenjo-Daro in Sindh, Pakistan. The village was inhabited between 4000 and 1700 BCE and is believed to have been a key center for carnelian bead production. It is the only Harappan city without a walled citadel. The site was discovered by N.G. Majumdar in 1931 and extensively excavated by Mackay in 1935-36. A significant discovery at Chanhu-Daro was a bead-making factory, complete with a furnace, underscoring its industrial nature. Kot Diji is a Harappan site: Kot Diji (now in Sindh, Pakistan) was an early Harappan site. Desalpur is a Harappan site: Desalpur is located in the Kutch District of Gujarat. It is famous for its disproportionately large fortifications.
